HomeV2.dc.html.title: Home v2: app list and three shortcuts

Password.dc.html.title: Sign in: password with the d-pad keyboard

v2.text: The four pins are gone. Tile 1 is the app list (A). Tiles 2 to 4 are shortcuts for planned features, shown here as Weather, Music and Friends. Each tile shows one glanceable fact instead of an icon: 18 degrees, resume, 2 friends online. d-pad left and right choose a tile, A opens it. Holding FUNC and pressing A, B, X or Y still jumps straight to tile 1 to 4.

lock.text: Shown after the screen timeout, and when you wake the device. Dark on purpose: it is easy on the eyes at night and saves power. Hours in paper, minutes in the accent colour. Tap FUNC to play or pause, hold FUNC for a second to unlock (the bar fills as you hold). While music plays the cover takes the clock's place and the time moves to the side.

signin.text: Sign in works with the d-pad and with touch. The on-screen keyboard moves with the d-pad (A types the key, B deletes, X shifts, FUNC signs in) and every key can also be tapped. The same keyboard will be used wherever the OS needs text. The optional PIN is a quick unlock for the lock screen; the account password is still what signs in after a restart.

how.text: Every frame is the real 320 x 240 screen at 2x. Press Play on a frame, then click All apps, the Music row or Back to walk the flow.

cover.text: While music plays, the cover art takes the clock's place: the big clock on Home, the side panel in Apps. The time moves into the title bar. The cover shown is a placeholder.

build.text: Mockups only. Nothing here is built into the OS yet. The accent colour is a tweak on each frame.
